text:
Lina (Design): hey all, uploaded a new prototype for batch-approve flows in prompt-evals. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/batch-approve-proto
Lina (Design): core ask: make bulk accept/reject fast but safe. want inline confirm, undo toast, and a clear audit path. also consider mobile gestures for reviewers on tablets.
Ethan (PM): sounds good. two guardrails: (1) explicit count in toolbar, (2) per-run failure handling so a partial failure surfaces.
Rae (Frontend): perf note: virtualized grid vs list again. bulk actions will operate on filter results too, so server-side paginated apply needs a job UI. For undo we can soft-toggle a flag client-side and call the API to revert after 10s if Undo pressed.
Noor (Accessibility): a11y checklist: bulk toolbar must be reachable by keyboard. modal confirmations should be aria-modal with focus trap. toast must use role="status" and the Undo button must be tabbable. please don't rely on color-only badges.
Carlos (SRE): audit/event note: accept/reject must emit an immutable audit event with user, timestamp, run id(s), and previous state. also rate-limit batch ops to avoid accidental huge changes.
Lina (Design): copy proposals: inline icon -> "Accept output". bulk button -> "Accept selected runs (N)". confirmation modal text: "This will mark N runs as accepted. You can undo from the activity log or with the Undo toast for 10s." any objections?
Ethan (PM): prefer explicit mention of undo in modal. also add a link to activity log in the modal footer.
Rae (Frontend): keyboard shortcut idea: when focus is on the list, press A to Accept selected, R to Reject. show a tooltip hint "A = Accept, R = Reject" in the sticky toolbar. implementation sketch:
```js
// pseudo
useHotkeys(['a','r'], (key) => {
  if (key === 'a') triggerAccept();
  if (key === 'r') triggerReject();
});
```
Rae (Frontend): will ensure shortcuts disabled when typing in a text field.
Noor (Accessibility): shortcut accessibility: inform screen readers when a shortcut is defined (announced via tooltip role="note"). also provide a menu entry for discoverability.
Lina (Design): mobile: propose long-press on a row to open action sheet (Accept / Reject / View diff). long-press shows small confirm for Accept to avoid fat-finger accepts.
Rae (Frontend): mobile gestures ok but needs a11y fallback. long-press must map to a context menu button for keyboard users. touch target size >=44px.
Carlos (SRE): backend: make batch ops idempotent and provide job status endpoint. UI should show per-run success/errors and let user retry failed ones.
ci-bot: CI report for branch feat/batch-approve: 
```
axe: color-contrast (BulkBadge)  contrast 2.3:1 against white
eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary
```
Noor (Accessibility): BulkBadge color needs darker tone or add a strong border. RowSummary must be interactive element (button) not div. also remember to add aria-live region for job status updates.
Rae (Frontend): will darken badge, replace RowSummary with a button, and add an aria-live region for job progress. will also implement the Undo logic with a 10s timeout and optimistic UI.
Lina (Design): small copy tweak: change "Accepted" toast to "Outputs accepted" and SR text to "N runs accepted. Undo". less ambiguous.
Ethan (PM): add telemetry: capture how often Undo is used in 10s window to tune confirmation timing.
Carlos (SRE): logging: include request id for batch ops to correlate UI job and backend logs. rate-limit alerts if >5000 runs in a single batch.
Noor (Accessibility): quick a11y test plan: keyboard flows for bulk toolbar, modal focus return after close, toast keyboard focus for Undo, and screen reader announcements for job completion. I'll run this after the branch lands.
Lina (Design): thanks folks. I'll update figma with confirm microcopy, mobile action sheet, and sticky toolbar hints. leaving thread open for final a11y/copy/telemetry notes. :white_check_mark:
